title: Completed constant realization of finite complexes and their reductions
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring, $I\subset A$ an ideal, and assume $P_n=A/I^n$ is finite for every $n$. Put $C=\varprojlim P_n$ and $J=IC$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Let $X$ be a scheme. On its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], put $\widehat A_X=\varprojlim\underline{P_n}$, using constant sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. For a finite $C$-module $N$ put $c_X(N)=\varprojlim_n\underline{N/J^nN}$. The functor $c_X$ from finitely generated $C$-modules to sheaves of $\widehat A_X$-modules is exact and its values are adic lisse of finite type [def-weil-pbc-adic-lisse-module]. For a bounded complex $Q$ of finite $C$-modules, write $c_X(Q)$ for its termwise realization. Then there are natural isomorphisms
$$c_X(Q)\otimes^L_{\widehat A_X}\underline{P_n}\simeq\underline{Q\otimes_C^L P_n}$$
in the derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], compatible with quotient transitions. For a scheme morphism $u:X\to T$, the same complex is a complex of $B=u^{-1}\widehat A_T$-modules via the projection-induced map $B\to\widehat A_X$ [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. There are natural isomorphisms
$$c_X(Q)\otimes_B^L u^{-1}\underline{(P_n)_T}\simeq\underline{Q\otimes_C^L P_n}_X.$$
These commute with all quotient reductions; no identification $u^{-1}\widehat A_T=\widehat A_X$ is asserted. Here derived tensors use K-flat resolutions as in [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings].
